I wrote the LRU cache solution to `main.wj`. It gives the expected output for Example 1 under `wj run --interpret`. I didn't run Example 2 or any other input, and I didn't run `wj build`, as instructed.

The cache keeps two parallel lists of keys and values, most recently used first. Capacity is at most 50, so the linear scans are fast enough.
